subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.*.sandbox.skipSkillsSync` as a permanent advanced configuration contract, or should preinstalled-skill optimization be declared by the sandbox backend instead?
rationale: The change adds public configuration and transfers materialization responsibility from OpenClaw to operators, so code correctness alone cannot select the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Sponsor after lifecycle repair
options.body: Accept the config option after removing destructive skip-mode cleanup and adding repeated-run live proof for an agent reading a preinstalled skill.

options.title: Use a backend capability
options.body: Replace the general config knob with a sandbox-backend capability that can guarantee where and when skills are materialized.

options.title: Decline the new contract
options.body: Close the PR and linked feature request if maintainers do not want another sandbox configuration and operator-owned fallback path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after lifecycle repair
recommendation.body: Accept the config option after removing destructive skip-mode cleanup and adding repeated-run live proof for an agent reading a preinstalled skill.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent sandbox backend and documentation history makes this the strongest available owner for the configuration-versus-backend product boundary.
